description: Use this when the user asks how their Meta (Facebook, Instagram) ads are doing. Spend, impressions, reach, clicks, CPM, CTR and key results (purchases, trials, registrations, leads, installs, checkouts…) with cost per result and ROAS, for a Meta ad account by account, campaign, ad set or ad. Use a date preset such as last_7d, or since/until dates. Set raw to get Meta's full action list.

account_id.description: Ad account id, e.g. act_123 (from meta_ad_accounts).

raw.description: Return every Meta action type instead of the summary.

name: meta_performance
title: Meta ad performance
